يختصروا (form VIII)
# يَخْتَصِرُوا (yaḵtaṣirū) /jax.ta.sˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# يُخْتَصَرُوا (yuḵtaṣarū) /jux.ta.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
